overview.text: Mike Porfirio has represented the 11th District in the Illinois Senate since 2023. He is a Bridgeview native, a U.S. Naval Academy graduate, and a Navy Reserve officer. He chairs the Senate Veterans Affairs Committee. His campaign says he led a law allowing local governments to address urgent road safety hazards. He says he secured $6 million for research into veteran suicide prevention therapies. He sponsored a bill to limit the use of artificial intelligence in community college instruction. He introduced a bill (SB2462) to repeal the 2015 law barring state pension investments in companies that boycott Israel. His campaign says he supported legislation to create a Northern Illinois Transit Authority to oversee the CTA, Metra, and Pace.
